verdict.rationale: Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger docs (all 404) and no public API reference site, but a live hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.reclaim.ai was detected via runtime probing, exposing OAuth-protected JSON-RPC access tied to the AI Assistant's 'MCP connectors' feature. This suggests some programmatic/agentic access exists, but it is not presented as a documented public API for general developers. Missing for 10: published API reference docs, OpenAPI/Swagger spec, explicit developer documentation describing endpoints/scopes beyond the bare OAuth metadata discovery.
